info.title: Z/X: Ignition
info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata in un futuro non troppo lontano nel quale improvvisamente, sulla Terra compaiono cinque "Buchi neri", in realtà  dei portali di mondi paralleli dai quali escono in breve tempo creature e abitanti di altri mondi (in realtà  provenienti dalla Terra nel futuro di diverse linee temporali). Gli invasori presto iniziano a combattersi per la supremazia, lotta cui dovranno unirsi anche gli abitanti del presente per la loro sopravvivenza...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious army appears in Kobe without warning. A state of emergency is declared, and a feirce battle between Z/X and Z/X begins. Azuma Tennoji fights with his partner Z/X Fierte to protect his beloved Kobe.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Ayase Kamiyugi and her black Z/X, Sieger, are after the angel who has fallen from the sky. Azuma tries hard to protect her, but that puts his own life in danger. Just when he thinks it's the end, he hears the voice of the mysterious girl he met.

episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Ayase Kamiyugi is known as the "Angel Killer" because of her repeated attacks on angels. On the 7th of January, she swore to take revenge on the angels who killed her family. She visits the spot where they died, and her dark past is revealed.
